label: Post-acute sequelae of COVID in children: Pulmonary assessment using impulse oscillometry and the effect of vaccination.
summary: Post-acute sequelae of SARS-CoV-2 infection (PASC), also known as long COVID syndrome (LCS), is characterized by persistent symptoms following SARS-CoV-2 infection and poses significant health challenges, particularly impacting pulmonary function in children. This study aims to evaluate the effect of COVID-19 vaccination on pulmonary function in children with PASC using standardized spirometry and impulse oscillometry (IOS).
